models_evaluated: deep learning anatomy recognition algorithm (daVinci SP retroperitoneal)

links.outcome: AI recognition timing versus operating surgeon for key anatomical structures
links.effect: Surgeon was first to recognize psoas (86.7%), renal artery (86.7%), kidney (73.3%); AI rarely first (psoas 6.7%, renal vein 13.3%); median Δ-time 12.0-85.0 s, p<0.01 for most structures.
links.quote: The surgeon was most frequently the first to recognize anatomical structures, including the psoas muscle (86.7%), renal artery (86.7%), and kidney (73.3%).

screen.reason: Prospective clinical evaluation of a real-time intraoperative computer vision tool identifying anatomical structures during robot-assisted surgery, comparing its performance/timing to the operating surgeon.
